text:
maria.sales: Quick heads-up — ACME Health (HIPAA pilot) asked for a hosted per-token concession for their 30d POC. They want $0.0003/token and no min charge. Current hosted list is $0.0006/token + $1k min for trials. Need deal-desk path. @emily.finance can you advise?
priya.se: Tech check: POC will use chat completions ~avg 512 tokens; they said latency <200ms p95. We can route them to a smaller model/quantized variant to save cost but quality risk. Could do prefix caching + batching.
jorge.ae: ACME is strategic — if POC converts they commit to 1-2M/mo first year. Close timeline: pilot start in 10 days. Sales asks for flexibility.
emily.finance: Put up front — any permanent override requires CFO signoff. For pilots we can do a temporary hosted override if they sign a Pilot Agreement and provide a card + PO. Proposed temporary: $0.00035/token with a $500 min for 30d. That gives us guardrails.
maria.sales: Thanks — can we fast-track deal-desk review? They need pricing in writing by EOD tomorrow.
tom.legal: We need DPA + HIPAA addendum on file before kickoff. I'll send our pilot addendum template. Also require engagement SOW referencing limited liability for pilot.
security-bot: Security questionnaire 3427 assigned to @priya.se and @maria.sales. SLA/security answers due in 4 business days. https://redwood.internal/secq/3427 :lock: 
priya.se: I'll take the questionnaire. Also, quick note — if we route to a quantized 8-bit variant we can hit the $0.00035 target on cost per token, but model quality will drop on medical prompts. Recommend we offer two options: (A) $0.00035/token on quantized model (labelled "pilot economy") or (B) $0.00045/token on standard model + $500 min. Let customer choose.
charles.sales: ACME care team prefers quality. They offered to compromise: if we do $0.00045/token + $250 min for 30d they'll sign pilot SOW immediately.
emily.finance: That's workable as an interim concession. Conditions: 1) Pilot Agreement signed, 2) card on file or PO >= $250, 3) pilot limited to hosted (no Dedicated), 4) auto-expire override after 30 days unless deal-desk authorizes extension.
maria.sales: I'll route the SOW + pricing option (B) to ACME now. Please queue deal-desk approval so we have an email trail. @tom.legal can you attach the HIPAA pilot addendum to the SOW?
tom.legal: On it. Sending draft now. Expect comments in ~2h.
priya.se: One more: to satisfy their latency SLAs we'll keep them on hosted with request routing to us-east-1 only. Add that to SOW.
jorge.ae: If ACME converts within 60 days, can we offer a rebate/credit for the pilot difference? That helps closing.
emily.finance: We can offer a one-time convert credit up to the difference between pilot price and standard list for the first invoice after conversion, capped at $5k, contingent on a signed 12mo commit. Add that to template for the deal-desk case.
maria.sales: Awesome — I'll update ACME and post the signed SOW when back. Folks, please react with :thumbsup: if you approve the temporary path: $0.00045/token + $250 min + pilot addendum + auto-expire 30d.
priya.se: :thumbsup:
emily.finance: :thumbsup: approved pending legal addendum
tom.legal: :thumbsup: uploading draft now
charles.sales: :thumbsup: sending to customer
security-bot: Note: questionnaire 3427 created — attach docs here once available.
